method: Source evaluated triangles, canonical transform, exact AABB exclusion, triangle SAT with 2 mm tolerance, and source vertex containment for large closed domes. Remaining non-dome pairs checked for source vertex containment in every individual watertight shell whose exact AABBs overlap.
caveat: No source contact detected is not proof of rigid-body separation: one non-dome watertight shell could fully contain another without triangle intersection. Only triangle intersection/containment rows establish geometric contact; source-separated AABB rows establish no contact.
